implementation_strategy: Use hosted OpenAI-compatible API ('gpt-5-mini') for all LLM calls. For each of the 300 preregistered tasks (100 benign / 100 ambiguous / 100 adversarial templates) execute paired modes deterministically: (1) baseline: single seeded generation → deterministic parser → simulator evaluation → deterministic scorer; (2) guarded: single seeded generation (shared initial candidate) → deterministic validator; if validator rejects, perform one deterministic repair-generation call (same model, recorded seed) → parser → simulator evaluation → deterministic scorer. All seeds, prompts, parser versions, simulator binary and inputs recorded. No human labour. All scoring and gating performed by deterministic code (validator + simulator + scorer).
public_resources: Preregistered synthetic prompt templates (benign/ambiguous/adversarial) — redacted public release for flagged adversarial items per contamination_plan
Isolated network simulator with deterministic reachability and policy-breach checks (public open-source simulator binary reference recorded in manifest)
Machine-readable preregistration (hosted-netops-gvr-v1-2026-08-26) and execution manifest (hashed internal artifacts)
model_and_version_plan: Baseline & guarded generation: gpt-5-mini (hosted_openai-compatible API) with per-call deterministic seed recorded
Repair-generation (guarded): gpt-5-mini, one allowed repair invocation per task when validator fails
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic template instantiation: 100 benign, 100 ambiguous, 100 adversarial tasks instantiated via fixed slot-fillers and hashed RNG seed. Adversarial templates produced by preregistered automated generators; examples redacted if flagged by exploit-pattern regex or embedding-similarity>0.95.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: direct_configuration_generation_v1 uses template→model→parser→simulator pipeline. Guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 applies deterministic validator rules to initial candidate and, if invalid, issues a single seeded repair-generation call; parser and simulator reuse same extraction schema.
randomisation_plan: Task ordering and audit-sample selection use a single experiment-wide deterministic RNG seed. Batches executed in deterministic order; within-batch task ordering hashed from seed to ensure reproducibility.
caching_plan: Cache all LLM responses, parser outputs, validator decisions, and simulator traces keyed by (task_id, prompt_hash, seed). Reuse cached artifacts for deterministic audit re-executions and retries. Cache TTL covers full experiment duration; no external egress.
failure_recovery_plan: Per missingness_plan: one automatic re-execution (same seed) for any timed-out or unparsable LLM call; if still failed, mark mode as 'failed_call'. Pairs with both modes failed excluded from primary complete-pair analysis and reported in failure table. All retries, rates and causes logged deterministically.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1: { task_id:int, prompt_family:string{benign|ambiguous|adversarial}, prompt_hash:string, baseline_outcome: {0,1,failed_call}, defended_outcome: {0,1,failed_call}, baseline_model_calls:int, defended_model_calls:int, validator_flag:boolean, parser_status:string, simulator_flags: {reachability_loss:boolean, policy_breach:boolean}, timestamp_iso:string, seeds:{baseline:int, defended_init:int, defended_repair:int|null} }
estimated_compute_notes: Model-call estimate derivation: 300 tasks × 1 initial generation each = 300 baseline/initial calls. Guarded mode allows at most one repair call per task; worst-case total calls = 300 initial + 300 repair = 600. Expected (conservative) defended repair rate ≈ 50% → estimated_model_calls = 300 initial + 150 repair = 450. Simulator CPU: one deterministic simulator run per model-proposed action per mode (≤600 simulator runs). Wall-clock feasibility: batched API calls (10 batches) executed within hosted API rate limits and 7-day wall-clock constraint. All totals recorded in manifest; maximum_model_calls enforced at 600.
